references.text: The same command to keep the commands that the Lord gives, so that they may prosper in the land they are about to enter.
A similar exhortation to keep all the commands in order to live, become numerous, and take possession of the land.
Moses exhorts the people to keep the statutes and laws so that they may live and enter the land.
The command to do as the Lord has commanded, without turning to the right or to the left.
The same promise that obedience to the commands will lead to their conquering the land and driving out the nations.
The Lord commands Joshua to be strong and courageous in order to lead the people into the land promised to them.
Joshua is told to prepare the people to cross the Jordan to take possession of the land the Lord gives them.
The promise that Israel will be God's treasured people if they keep his covenant and obey his voice.
An exhortation to keep all the Lord's statutes and laws, so that the land may not vomit them out.
